# Viraj Patel — Software Engineer

Viraj Patel, known online as angrybayblade, is a software engineer based in Bengaluru, India. He builds developer platforms, SDKs, orchestration systems, and open-source infrastructure at early-stage startups. He works across backend infrastructure and developer experience and is comfortable owning ambiguous problems from idea through production.

## Selected impact

- Rebuilt orchestration infrastructure for an 11× throughput improvement.
- Developed deployment tooling that reduced deployment time by 95–99%.
- Built a tool-execution runtime, versioning service, OpenAPI-to-tool generation pipeline, SDKs, and plugin ecosystems.
- Built SWEKIT, which scored 48.6% on SWE Bench at the time.

## Experience

### Composio — Founding Engineer, May 2024 to September 2025

Led tooling infrastructure and developer-experience work, including scalable tool execution, versioning, OpenAPI-based tool generation, reusable internal abstractions, SDKs, and early product experiments.

### Valory AG — Engineering roles, September 2021 to May 2024

Built open-source frameworks, orchestration and deployment tooling, static-analysis systems, autonomous-service prototypes, and plugins for blockchain networks and wallets. Progressed from junior Python developer to Python engineer and SDK engineering lead, then senior Python engineer.

### Google Summer of Code — Intern, May 2021 to August 2021

Worked with Emory School of Medicine on a low-code neural-network platform using TensorFlow. Improved the development workflow, built a JSON-to-Python transpiler, and introduced an in-browser code editor.

## Skills

Python, JavaScript, Go, Flask, Django, React, Next.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Web3, IPFS, Linux, network programming, asynchronous programming, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes.
